name: 了 for a completed action
instruction: A finished action, followed by something else.

name: 了 for a change of state
instruction: Something that was not true and now is.

name: Adverbs before the verb
instruction: 已经, 常常, 也, 都 between subject and verb.

name: Number + measure word + noun
instruction: Counting anything.

name: 吗 for yes-no questions
instruction: A statement turned into a question.

name: 是 between two nouns
instruction: One thing identified as another — the only slot 是 belongs in.

name: Adjectives take no 是
instruction: Describing something; 很 holds the slot English fills with 'is'.

name: 有 for having, 没有 to deny it
instruction: Owning something or not — 不 cannot touch 有.

name: 不 against 没
instruction: Denying a habit or an intention, against denying that something happened.

name: Place + 有 + thing
instruction: Saying what is somewhere; the place goes first.

name: 上, 里, 下 after the noun
instruction: A place made out of an object — English needs nothing extra, Mandarin does.

name: 在 + place before the verb
instruction: Where an action happens, said before the action.

name: Time before the verb
instruction: When something happens, said before the verb and never after.

name: Largest unit first
instruction: A date, a time or an address with more than one unit in it.

name: Verb 不 verb questions
instruction: A yes-no question asked without 吗.

name: 还是 for offering a choice
instruction: A question offering two options — not the 'or' of a statement.
examples: 我们今天去还是明天去？

name: Question words stay put
instruction: Asking who, what or where; the question word sits where the answer would.

name: 二 against 两
instruction: Two as a count, against two as a label.

name: 呢 to turn the question back
instruction: Answering, then asking the same thing back.

name: 吧 for a suggestion
instruction: Proposing something, or softening an order into an offer.

name: Two verbs, nothing between them
instruction: Going somewhere in order to do something.

name: 会 against 能
instruction: A skill that was learned, against a possibility open right now.

name: 的 for whose, and where it drops
instruction: Possession — dropped before family and close relations, kept everywhere else.

name: 在 and 正在 for an action underway
instruction: Something happening at this moment.

name: 一 changes tone
instruction: 一 in front of a measure word or another syllable.

name: 不 changes tone
instruction: 不 in front of a fourth-tone syllable.

name: 过 for experience
instruction: Having done something at least once.

name: Clauses keep their subject
instruction: 因为 / 所以 clauses where English would drop the subject.

name: 虽然…但是 concession pair
instruction: Both halves marked; English marks only one.

name: 得 for how an action goes
instruction: Evaluating an action rather than a thing.

name: Resultative complements
instruction: 吃完, 听懂, 走出去 — the result fused to the verb.

name: 是…的 for circumstances
instruction: Emphasising when, where or how a known past event happened.

name: 比 for comparing two things
instruction: One thing measured against another.

name: The size of the gap, after the adjective
instruction: A comparison with how much stated.

name: 没有 for falling short
instruction: Denying a comparison — 不比 does not mean this.

name: Doubled verbs for a quick try
instruction: Doing something briefly, or softening a request into a favour.

name: Doubled adjectives
instruction: A description made vivid rather than measured.

name: 的, 地, 得
instruction: One sound, three slots: before a noun, before a verb, after one.

name: How, before the verb
instruction: The manner of an action, said before the action.

name: 着 for a state that holds
instruction: Something left in a condition rather than done.

name: Place + verb 着 + thing
instruction: Describing what is in a place by how it sits there.

name: 来 and 去 on the verb
instruction: Movement described from where the speaker stands.

name: 快要…了 for what is about to happen
instruction: Something imminent; the 了 at the end is not optional.

name: 一…就… for the moment after
instruction: One thing following another with no gap, or following it every time.
examples: 他一到家就给我打电话

name: 给 + person before the verb
instruction: Doing something for someone, where English puts them last.

name: 跟 + person before the verb
instruction: Doing something with someone; the companion precedes the verb.

name: 从…到… for a span
instruction: A stretch of time or distance with both ends named.

name: 别 for telling someone to stop
instruction: A negative command, not a statement about the future.

name: 请, 让, 叫 + person + verb
instruction: Getting someone else to act; the person is object and subject at once.

name: How long, after the verb
instruction: How long something lasted; with an object the verb repeats.

name: How many times, after the verb
instruction: Counting occurrences of an action.

name: The object first, as topic
instruction: Something already under discussion, commented on rather than introduced.

name: No pronoun for a thing already named
instruction: English needs 'it'; the slot stays empty here.

name: 还是…吧 for the better option
instruction: Settling on a course after weighing it.

name: 都…了 for how far it has got
instruction: Pointing out that something has reached a surprising point.

name: Two third tones in a row
instruction: The first of two third tones rises instead.

name: 把 to front the object
instruction: Something concrete done to a definite object, with a result.

name: 被 for something done to you
instruction: Something unwelcome that happened to the subject.

name: 如果…就…
instruction: A condition and its consequence, both marked.
examples: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了

name: …的话 for a supposed case
instruction: A condition tagged onto the end of the clause instead of the front.
examples: 你不喜欢的话，可以换一个

name: 不但…而且…
instruction: Two things true of one subject, the second going further than the first.
examples: 他不但会说中文，而且说得很好

name: 只要…就…
instruction: The one condition that is enough.

name: 只有…才…
instruction: The only condition under which it can happen at all.

name: 越…越…
instruction: One thing rising as another rises.

name: 越来越 for a growing trend
instruction: Something increasing over time with nothing to measure it against.

name: 除了…以外，还 or 都
instruction: One thing set aside — whether the rest joins it or is excluded turns on 还 against 都.
examples: 除了他以外，我们都去了
除了英语以外，她还会法语

name: 得 or 不 inside the verb
instruction: Whether the action can reach its result — not permission, not skill.

name: 极了 and 得很 after the adjective
instruction: An intensity 很 cannot carry.

name: 得, 应该, 必须
instruction: An obligation, graded from advisable to unavoidable.

name: 不用 and 不必 for no need
instruction: Releasing someone from an obligation, not forbidding them.

name: Verbs that split
instruction: 见面, 帮忙, 结婚 — the object is already inside, so everything else goes between.

name: Question word swept up by 都
instruction: Nobody, nothing, nowhere.

name: Question words for something unnamed
instruction: Some thing or person left vague, inside a statement rather than a question.

name: The verb said twice
instruction: Judging an action that has an object; the verb repeats before 得.

name: 一边…一边…
instruction: Two actions running at once.

name: 又…又…
instruction: Two qualities holding at the same time.

name: 先…然后 or 再…
instruction: Steps in an order that matters.

name: 才 against 就
instruction: Later or harder than expected, against sooner or easier.

name: 又 against 再
instruction: Repeated already, against still to be repeated.

name: 对…来说
instruction: Whose vantage point a judgement holds from.

name: 为了 for the point of doing it
instruction: The purpose stated first, the action after.
examples: 为了考试，他每天复习到很晚

name: 到, 住, 上, 走 as results
instruction: The action succeeded, stuck, closed, or took something away.

name: 起来, 下去, 出来 with nobody moving
instruction: Something starting, being kept up, or coming to mind.

name: 跟…一样
instruction: Two things equal, or equally something.

name: 不是…吗 for a reminder
instruction: A question whose point is that the answer is already obvious.

name: 以前 and 以后 after the clause
instruction: One event placed against another; the marker comes last, not first.

name: 儿 on the end
instruction: 一点儿, 玩儿, 哪儿 — the bare noun sounds bookish said aloud.

name: 不管 or 无论…都…
instruction: Every case leading to the same outcome.
examples: 不管天气怎么样，我都去

name: 既然…就…
instruction: Acting on something both sides already accept.
examples: 既然你不舒服，就早点儿休息吧

name: 即使…也…
instruction: A concession made to something hypothetical.
examples: 即使失败了，也值得试一试

name: 就是…也… in speech
instruction: 即使 as it is actually said out loud.

name: 尽管…但是…
instruction: A fact conceded and then set aside; heavier than 虽然.
examples: 尽管条件很差，但是他们坚持下来了

name: 不是…而是…
instruction: Correcting a wrong assumption and supplying the right one.
examples: 这不是钱的问题，而是态度问题

name: 不是…就是…
instruction: Only two possibilities, and it is always one of them.
examples: 他不是在看书，就是在打球

name: 既…又 or 也…
instruction: Two qualities held together as one judgement.
examples: 这个方法既省时间，又省钱

name: 一方面…另一方面…
instruction: Two sides of one situation, weighed.
examples: 一方面工资高，另一方面压力也大

name: 连…都…
instruction: The least likely case, offered to settle the rest.
examples: 他连自己的名字都不会写

name: 却 before the verb
instruction: A contrast carried by an adverb instead of a conjunction at the front.

name: 难道…吗
instruction: Disbelief put as a question that expects no answer.

name: 把 for a thorough going-over
instruction: Doing something to an object once through, or for a set stretch.
examples: 把房间打扫了半个小时

name: 叫 and 让 as spoken passives
instruction: 被 as speech prefers it, with the doer named.

name: 使 for what a situation does to you
instruction: A circumstance producing a reaction in someone.
examples: 这个消息使大家很高兴

name: 不如 for falling short
instruction: Ranking one option below another.

name: 不得不, 不能不, 没有不
instruction: An assertion strengthened by denying its opposite twice.

name: 差点儿 for the near miss
instruction: Something bad that almost happened and did not.

name: 得了 and 不了 on the verb
instruction: Whether the amount or the distance can be managed at all.

name: 死了, 坏了, 得厉害
instruction: An intensity stated as damage.

name: 对于 and 关于 at the front
instruction: Naming the matter first, then saying something about it.
examples: 对于这个问题，我有不同的看法
关于明天的会议，我想说几句

name: 随着 for what shifts alongside
instruction: One thing changing as another develops.
examples: 随着经济的发展，人们的生活越来越好

name: 由于…因此… in writing
instruction: 因为…所以 as a report would put it.
examples: 由于天气原因，航班取消了
由于成本上升，因此价格也作了调整

name: 否则 for what happens otherwise
instruction: A condition and the consequence of missing it.
examples: 你得早点儿出发，否则会迟到

name: 一A一B, 有A有B, 无A无B
instruction: A four-character pair standing where a whole description would.

name: 来得及 and 来不及
instruction: Whether there is still time for it.

name: 说不定
instruction: A guess offered as a real possibility.

name: 再也不…了
instruction: Never again, said as a resolution.

name: 怎么也 or 都 + 不
instruction: Failing no matter what is tried.
examples: 我怎么也想不起来他的名字

name: 好 for so that
instruction: Doing one thing to make a second thing possible.
examples: 你把地址写下来，我好去找你

name: 在…方面
instruction: Narrowing a judgement to one aspect of something.
examples: 他在语言方面很有天赋

name: Several modifiers, one noun
instruction: Which of them take 的 and which do not.
examples: 一位很有经验的中国老师

name: The second syllable losing its tone
instruction: 东西, 大意, 地道 — a different word when the tone stays on.

name: 一旦…就…
instruction: Once it happens, what follows is settled.
examples: 一旦决定了，就不要后悔

name: 万一 for the unlikely case
instruction: Planning against something improbable and unwelcome.
examples: 万一他不来，我们怎么办？

name: 假如 for a supposition
instruction: 如果 in a more formal frame.
examples: 假如没有这次机会，结果会完全不同

name: 哪怕…也…
instruction: A concession made to the most extreme case.
examples: 哪怕只有一点儿希望，也要试试

name: 不但不…反而…
instruction: The expected thing failed to happen and the opposite did.
examples: 他不但不感谢我，反而怪我多管闲事

name: 反而 for the opposite result
instruction: An outcome running against what the situation set up.

name: 再…也…
instruction: However much of it, still no difference.

name: 没有…就没有…
instruction: One thing wholly dependent on another.
examples: 没有大家的帮助，就没有今天的成绩

name: 要不然 for the alternative
instruction: 否则 as it is said rather than written.
examples: 快点儿走吧，要不然就赶不上了

name: 从而 for what it thereby brings about
instruction: A result the first action made possible.
examples: 公司改进了流程，从而降低了成本

name: 可见 for what it shows
instruction: A conclusion drawn off what was just stated.
examples: 他连夜赶来，可见这件事有多重要

name: 总之 to wrap up
instruction: Closing several points with one.
examples: 总之，这件事还需要再考虑

name: 自从…以来
instruction: A stretch running from a starting point up to now.
examples: 自从来到这里以来，他变了很多

name: 起来, 下来, 下去 as aspect
instruction: A state setting in, settling, or being kept up.

name: 得 with a whole clause behind it
instruction: A reaction described by its consequences instead of an adjective.

name: 把…当作 or 看成
instruction: Treating one thing as though it were another.
examples: 别把这件事看得太严重

name: 被…给…
instruction: A passive with the extra 给 speech puts in anyway.

name: 居然 for what should not have happened
instruction: Surprise that it turned out that way at all.
examples: 他居然一句话也没说就走了

name: 根本 for not in the slightest
instruction: A denial pushed back to the premise.

name: 简直 for beyond describing
instruction: An exaggeration offered as the only fair description.

name: 反正 for it makes no difference
instruction: Setting the reasons aside because the outcome is fixed.
examples: 反正我也没事，就陪你去吧

name: 果然 for as expected
instruction: Something predicted and then confirmed.

name: 似乎 and 仿佛
instruction: 好像 in writing.
examples: 仿佛一切都没有发生过

name: 凭 and 据 for what it rests on
instruction: The grounds or the source behind a claim or an action.
examples: 据我所知，他已经离职了

name: 替 for in someone's place
instruction: Doing something instead of the person whose job it was.

name: A来A去
instruction: Doing something over and over, usually to no end.
examples: 想来想去还是决定不去

name: A着A着
instruction: Something breaking in partway through an action.

name: 没A没B
instruction: A four-character complaint about something with no limits.

name: Stacked adverbials in order
instruction: Time, then scope, then manner, then place — all in front of the verb.
examples: 他昨天在公司很认真地看了那份报告

name: 有着 for abstract possession
instruction: 有 where the thing held is a quality or a history.
examples: 这座城市有着悠久的历史

name: 得不得了
instruction: An intensity past the point of stating.

name: Classifiers that carry a picture
instruction: 朵, 颗, 支, 匹 — where 个 would lose the shape of the thing.

name: 要么…要么…
instruction: Two options, one of which has to be taken.
examples: 要么现在就走，要么明天再说

name: 除非…才…
instruction: The single exception that makes it possible.
examples: 除非你亲自去，他才会答应

name: 除非…否则…
instruction: One condition, and the consequence of failing it.
examples: 除非提前预约，否则进不去

name: 凡是…都…
instruction: A rule applied to every member of a class, no exceptions.
examples: 凡是报名的人都可以参加

name: 就算…也…
instruction: 即使 as speech grants a point.
examples: 就算你说得对，也不该这么做

name: 以便 for so as to
instruction: 为了 pointed forward, in a notice or a report.
examples: 请提前提交材料，以便及时审核

name: 所 in front of the verb
instruction: What is done, turned into a noun.

name: 为…所…
instruction: 被 in its written form.
examples: 这一观点为大家所接受

name: 于 fused to the verb
instruction: 位于, 属于, 在于, 来源于.
examples: 这座桥建于一九六八年

name: 至于 to turn to the next matter
instruction: Moving on once the first thing is settled.
examples: 至于费用问题，我们下次再谈

name: 不料 for what nobody expected
instruction: A turn that overturns the plan just described.
examples: 本想早点儿出发，不料路上堵车

name: —化 for turning into
instruction: A process named as a noun where English needs a clause.

name: —性 for the quality of being
instruction: An adjective turned into the property it names.

name: 无—, 非—, 超—, 反—
instruction: A negation or an intensification carried by a bound prefix.

name: 明明 for the plain fact being ignored
instruction: Something obviously true, set against what followed anyway.
examples: 他明明知道，却什么也没说

name: 未必 for not necessarily
instruction: Doubting a conclusion without denying it.

name: 倒 for the other way round
instruction: A mild contradiction of what was assumed.
examples: 这个办法倒是可以试试

name: 干脆 for cutting it short
instruction: Abandoning the half measure for the blunt option.

name: 总算 for at long last
instruction: 终于 with the trouble it cost still in view.
examples: 等了三个小时，总算轮到我们了

name: 把 with a situation as subject
instruction: A circumstance, not a person, doing something to something.
examples: 一场大雨把比赛推迟了

name: 透了 for utterly
instruction: A bad state carried to its limit.

name: A这A那
instruction: Fussing over one thing then another, disapprovingly.

name: 左A右B
instruction: Doing something from every angle, over and over.

name: X归X，Y归Y
instruction: Conceding one thing while keeping it apart from another.
examples: 朋友归朋友，生意归生意

name: 到…为止
instruction: A count or a state running up to a stated cut-off.

name: 好不容易
instruction: Something got only after real trouble.

name: 嘛, 啦, 呗
instruction: Ending a sentence to mark it obvious, settled, or resigned.

name: 人家 for the other party
instruction: Someone else, or the speaker referring to themselves with a complaint.

name: 仍旧 and 依旧
instruction: 还是 in writing.

name: 一再 and 再三
instruction: Something done again and again, insistently.

name: 特意 and 特地
instruction: Going out of one's way for a single purpose.

name: 串, 滴, 扇, 枝
instruction: Classifiers chosen for the picture they carry.

name: 宁可…也不…
instruction: Taking the worse option to avoid a worse one still.
examples: 宁可自己吃亏，也不愿麻烦别人

name: 与其…不如…
instruction: Rejecting one course in favour of another.
examples: 与其在这儿等，不如先回去

name: 之所以…是因为…
instruction: The result stated first, the reason held back.
examples: 他之所以成功，是因为从不轻易放弃

name: 别说…，都或也…
instruction: Ruling out the larger case because the smaller one already fails.
examples: 别说一千块，一百块我都拿不出来

name: …不说，还…
instruction: One complaint, then a worse one on top of it.

name: 尚且…，何况…
instruction: True in the easier case, so certainly true in the harder one.
examples: 专家尚且没有把握，何况我们

name: 连…都…，更不用说…了
instruction: The minimum failing, so everything above it is out of the question.
examples: 他连汉字都认不全，更不用说读小说了

name: 一来…，二来…
instruction: Reasons counted off in order.
examples: 一来时间不够，二来经费也有限

name: 一则…，二则…
instruction: 一来二来 in writing.
examples: 一则可以省钱，二则可以省时间

name: 纵然…，也…
instruction: 即使 at its most formal.
examples: 纵然困难重重，也不能就此放弃

name: 幸亏…，不然…
instruction: A near miss avoided by one lucky circumstance.
examples: 幸亏你提醒我，不然就忘了

name: 故 for therefore
instruction: 所以 in formal prose.
examples: 因证据不足，故不予受理

name: 以至于 for the point it reached
instruction: A cause carried far enough to produce a stated extreme.
examples: 他太投入了，以至于忘了时间

name: 鉴于 for in view of
instruction: A circumstance offered as the grounds for a decision.
examples: 鉴于目前的情况，会议推迟举行

name: 本着 and 基于
instruction: Acting on a stated principle, or reasoning from a stated basis.
examples: 基于以上分析，我们建议暂缓

name: 况且 for and besides
instruction: An extra reason added once the argument is already made.
examples: 路太远了，况且我也没时间

name: 免得 and 以防
instruction: Doing something to head off a specific trouble.
examples: 提前打个电话，免得白跑一趟

name: 若, 倘若, 假使
instruction: 如果 in a document.
examples: 若有疑问，请与我们联系
倘若属实，后果不堪设想

name: 非得…才…
instruction: Insisting that nothing short of this will do.
examples: 非得亲眼看见才肯相信

name: 任…也…
instruction: 无论 compressed into a single clause.
examples: 任你怎么说，他也不改主意

name: 为…起见
instruction: A precaution named as the reason for a measure.
examples: 为安全起见，请系好安全带

name: 以 for in order to
instruction: 为了 moved to the second half, in official prose.

name: 优于, 胜过, 高于
instruction: 比 replaced by a verb in a written comparison.
examples: 新方案明显优于旧方案

name: 无非…罢了, 不过…而已
instruction: Playing something down to nothing more than what is stated.

name: 总而言之, 简言之, 综上所述
instruction: Closing an argument in writing.
examples: 综上所述，这一做法并不可取

name: 换句话说, 反过来说
instruction: Restating the same point from the other side.
examples: 换句话说，问题出在流程上

name: 虽说…，但…
instruction: 虽然 as speech concedes a point.
examples: 虽说年纪不小了，但身体还很硬朗

name: 别看…，…
instruction: Warning against a judgement made on appearances.
examples: 别看他年轻，经验很丰富

name: X倒是X了，…
instruction: Granting that it happened, then the complaint.
examples: 东西买倒是买了，就是不太合适

name: 成语 for effort and persistence
instruction: 全力以赴, 坚持不懈, 半途而废 — where a clause would go flabby.
examples: 他全力以赴地准备这次比赛

name: 成语 for quantity and crowds
instruction: 人山人海, 络绎不绝, 屈指可数.

name: 成语 for time and speed
instruction: 争分夺秒, 日新月异, 转眼之间.

name: 无论…与否，都…
instruction: Both answers to a yes-or-no question leading to the same thing.
examples: 无论成功与否，都要认真总结

name: 凡…者，均…
instruction: 凡是…都 as regulations put it.
examples: 凡逾期未缴者，均按违约处理

name: 值此…之际
instruction: A ceremonial opening for an occasion.
examples: 值此新春佳节之际，谨致以诚挚的问候

name: 向…致以…
instruction: Formal conveying of thanks, greetings, or condolences.
examples: 向全体员工致以衷心的感谢

name: 因…而…
instruction: Cause and effect compressed into one clause.
examples: 他因表现优异而获得晋升

name: 在…之余
instruction: What gets done alongside or after the main business.
examples: 在工作之余，他还坚持写作

name: 莫过于
instruction: Naming the extreme case of a category.
examples: 最令人感动的莫过于此

name: 不亚于, 仅次于
instruction: Ranking something level with a known benchmark, or just under it.
examples: 其影响不亚于一场革命

name: 视…而定
instruction: An outcome left to hang on a stated factor.

name: 所谓…，就是…
instruction: Defining a term the moment it is introduced.
examples: 所谓共享经济，就是把闲置资源重新配置

name: 有所 + two-syllable verb
instruction: A change acknowledged without measuring it.
examples: 双方在这一问题上有所保留

name: 予以 and 加以
instruction: The verb turned into an object and handed to a light verb.
examples: 这些问题必须加以解决

name: 并非 for it is not the case
instruction: 不是 in formal denial.

name: 可谓 for it may be called
instruction: A summing-up judgement in written prose.

name: 免不了 and 难免
instruction: Something unwelcome that could not have been avoided.

name: 巴不得 and 恨不得
instruction: Wanting something so badly the wish turns absurd.

name: 犯不着 and 犯得着
instruction: Judging something not worth the trouble it costs.
examples: 犯不着为这点儿小事生气

name: 动不动就…
instruction: A habit of doing something at the slightest provocation.

name: 爱A不A
instruction: Washing one's hands of someone else's choice.

name: 得要命 and 得要死
instruction: An intensity stated as a threat to life.

name: 看在…的面子上
instruction: Conceding something for a third party's sake.
examples: 看在老朋友的面子上，就算了吧

name: 没什么好…的
instruction: Dismissing a topic as not worth the action.

name: X也好，Y也罢
instruction: Two cases named and then made irrelevant.
examples: 成功也好，失败也罢，都是收获

name: 与其说…不如说…
instruction: Rejecting one characterisation for a truer one.
examples: 与其说是运气，不如说是准备充分

name: 何必, 何苦, 何不
instruction: Advice or reproach put as a question that expects no answer.

name: One subject across several clauses
instruction: A chain of clauses about the same person; repeating them reads as translation.
examples: 他推开门，走进屋子，坐了下来

name: A topic held across clauses
instruction: One thing set up first, then several comments on it without naming it again.
examples: 这本书我买了三年，一直放在书架上，到现在也没看完

name: 成语 for how someone speaks
instruction: 滔滔不绝, 直言不讳, 支支吾吾.
examples: 他一说起来就滔滔不绝

name: 成语 for trouble and urgency
instruction: 迫在眉睫, 束手无策, 举步维艰.
examples: 面对这种局面，大家束手无策

name: 成语 for likeness and difference
instruction: 截然不同, 大同小异, 相辅相成.

name: 不A不B, 非A非B, 无A不B
instruction: A four-character frame built out of two negations.

name: 老实说, 说真的, 话说回来
instruction: Marking a turn in what you are saying before you make it.
examples: 老实说，我也没什么把握

name: 乃 for formal identification
instruction: 是 in classical-flavoured written judgement.

name: 岂 for surely not
instruction: 难道 in literary rhetoric.

name: 无从, 无可, 无须, 不容
instruction: A formal denial that there is any way, any room, or any need.

name: 以…为…
instruction: Naming what something takes as its basis, its example, or its focus.

name: 而 joining clauses
instruction: A link that is neither 和 nor 但是, carrying contrast or consequence by position alone.

name: 据…所知, 据悉
instruction: Attributing a claim to a source without naming one.
examples: 据我所知，情况并非如此

name: 纵观…，不难发现…
instruction: Surveying a field, then drawing the conclusion off it.
examples: 纵观全局，不难发现问题的根源

name: 截至, 迄今为止, 时至今日
instruction: A count or a state fixed at a formal cut-off.
examples: 截至目前，已有三千人报名
时至今日，这一问题仍未解决

name: 令 and 使 without a person as subject
instruction: A development producing a reaction, stated impersonally.

name: 在…的同时，也…
instruction: Two things held true of one development at once.
examples: 在提高效率的同时，也降低了成本

name: 不仅…更是…
instruction: 递进 escalated in argument.
examples: 这不仅是技术问题，更是管理问题

name: 之 inside a written noun phrase
instruction: 的 in a fixed literary shape, or 之 standing in for the object.

name: Matched four-character clauses
instruction: Two or three four-character units in step, carrying one point.

name: 于 after the adjective
instruction: A comparison made without 比.

name: 且, 乃至, 加之
instruction: Written conjunctions stacking clauses in a report.
examples: 影响遍及全国乃至海外

name: 关键在于, 问题在于
instruction: Locating the crux of the matter.

name: 无论如何
instruction: Insisting on something regardless of everything just raised.

name: 退一步说
instruction: Giving ground on purpose, to make the argument harder to refuse.
examples: 退一步说，就算他不同意，我们也可以先做

name: 归根到底
instruction: Reducing an argument to its root.
examples: 归根到底还是钱的问题

name: 你还别说, 这不, 说到哪儿去了
instruction: Steering a conversation with a phrase that carries no content.
examples: 你还别说，这个办法真管用

name: 也罢, 矣
instruction: Literary sentence-final particles of resignation or finality.

name: 成语 for scene and atmosphere
instruction: 鸟语花香, 万籁俱寂, 美不胜收.

name: 成语 for weighing and reasoning
instruction: 权衡利弊, 循序渐进, 因势利导.
examples: 权衡利弊之后，他选择了留下

name: 成语 for criticising a course of action
instruction: 一意孤行, 舍本逐末, 因噎废食.
examples: 这样做无异于舍本逐末

name: 成语 for what a person is like
instruction: 德高望重, 平易近人, 深藏不露.

name: 成语 for how it turned out
instruction: 水到渠成, 事与愿违, 功亏一篑.
examples: 准备充分，成功水到渠成
